title: CHINAGRAPH
description: Marked for keeps. A deadstock fashion label edited on a contact sheet: a loupe sweeps the roll, six frames get looped in grease pencil, and each enlarges to a full-screen look in a strobe flash.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · AI-generated stills · Lenis

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: logo, a live **frame counter** ("Frame 04 / 12"), nav (Sheet, Looks, Cloth, Shop, Request) with one yellow indicator that slides, and a **Bag** button with a count that pops and a popover (lines, remove, subtotal, "checkout off in this template"). Hides on scroll-down, inverts to light over the shop, yellow progress hairline. Below 1080 px a full-screen menu opening with a clip-path circle.

sections.title: Sheet (`#sheet`, the hero)
sections.summary: left: eyebrow, h1 "Marked / for keeps.", lead, CTAs (See the six looks, Shop the collection), counter cue. Right: the contact sheet: flash-white paper, a header row ("Chinagraph 120 · Roll 07 · 12 exp · pushed +1"), three black film strips of four square frames with mono edge print above and below, frame numbers, and a yellow `GreaseLoop` SVG (pathLength 1, tilted per frame) round each select. A loupe ring with crosshair ticks.

sections.title: Looks (`#looks`)
sections.summary: six full-bleed looks (Box Coat £640 navy melton, Work Jacket £420 black waxed cotton, Pleat Trouser £290 charcoal flannel, Rollneck £260 bone boiled wool, DB Suit £980 rain-grey gabardine, Car Coat £1,120 oxblood leather offcuts), each with a mini 12-square rail circling its frame, "Look 02 · Frame 04 / 12", a giant name, cloth / origin / price, a note, a "Shop the …" button and a close-crop detail card.

sections.title: Cloth (`#cloth`)
sections.summary: "Cut from what was left.", a counter to **1,140 m** of deadstock, a horizontal snap strip of four macros (Melton, Huddersfield 1968, 420 m; Waxed cotton, Dundee 1994, 260 m; Flannel, Biella 2011, 300 m; Gabardine, Lancashire 1979, 160 m) with drag on fine pointers and arrow buttons.

sections.title: Shop (`#shop`, flash-white)
sections.summary: six product cards: flat lay that wipes to the on-model roll frame (hover on fine pointers, or an "On model" toggle everywhere), native radio size chips with sold-out sizes disabled and struck, an add button that goes "Pick a size" → "Add to bag · £640" → "Adding" → "In the bag ✓". One in-memory bag store (`useSyncExternalStore` + a tested reducer).

sections.title: Request (`#request`)
sections.summary: "Get the sheet in the post." A form (name, email, street, city, country select, "who is it for" chips) with local validation, a one-shot shake and focus on the first error; submit → "Exposing" → a print slip ("It's on the drying line.", run number `No. 0412` from a stable hash, rows printing in, a yellow loop drawn round KEEP). No network request.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: a film-edge marquee, stockists (London studio, Antwerp, Copenhagen, Tokyo), links, small print ("fictional label, AI-generated photographs"), a giant wordmark.
